premises.text: Streaming economics make it very hard for artists to earn a living because music is assumed to be free
premises.evidence_span: Nearly a generation has grown up assuming music is or should be free. And this has made it very hard for artists to make a living today

premises.text: Space Bar streams live audio performances to mobile devices as original unique content beyond recorded catalogs
premises.evidence_span: Space Bar streams live audio performances to mobile devices

premises.text: Fans can sample free previews and pay 99 cents to join a live show from anywhere
premises.evidence_span: For 99 cents, it's as though I'm there

premises.text: Live-stream listenership data helps bands plan tours and venues book emerging acts
premises.evidence_span: It will help them plan their tours. It's business intelligence that will help venues book the hottest new acts

premises.text: Launch distribution through influential NYC clubs plus Backplane artist communities enables scale to superstar audiences
premises.evidence_span: we're delighted to launch Space Bar from some of the most influential clubs in New York City

premises.text: Simple push-button broadcast architecture lets anyone go live from a phone and reach fans worldwide
premises.evidence_span: We crafted a beautifully simple architecture that just works so that when superstars take the stage, they can reach out to all of their fans all over the world

value.text: Musicians better connect with fans and fans who wish to support artists can do so directly while hearing live shows anywhere
value.evidence_span: help musicians to better connect with their fans and to build a mobile platform to help those fans that wish to support artists to directly do so
